children: Vancouver, British Columbia – TheNewswire – September 24, 2026 – Solid Impact Investments Corp. (TSXV: SOLI.P) ("Impact" or the "Company"), a capital pool company, is pleased to announce that the Company has been granted an extension by the TSX Venture Exchange ("TSXV") to complete the non-brokered private placement, as previously announced on August 14, 2026 (the “Private Placement”) of up to 60,000,000 common shares of the Company (each, a “Common Share”) at a price of CAD$0.05 per Common Share for gross proceeds of up to CAD$3,000,000. The Company has now until October 21, 2026, to complete the Private Placement.

The net proceeds from the Private Placement will be used for general working capital and towards any costs associated with a future qualifying transaction as such a term is defined in Policy 2.4 – “Capital Pool Companies” of the Exchange. Finder’s fees may be payable in respect of some subscriptions.
The closing of the Private Placement is subject to the approval of the TSX Venture Exchange. All securities issued under the Private Placement will be subject to a four-month hold period.
